name: create_property_setup
signature: p_property_type property_type, p_city cavite_city, p_barangay text, p_public_lat double precision, p_public_lng double precision, p_address_line_1 text, p_exact_lat double precision, p_exact_lng double precision, p_amenity_ids bigint[], p_address_line_2 text, p_postal_code text, p_access_instructions text, p_bedrooms smallint, p_bathrooms numeric, p_floor_area_sqm numeric, p_floor_number smallint, p_total_floors smallint, p_furnishing_status furnishing_status, p_max_occupants smallint
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_property_setup(p_property_type property_type, p_city cavite_city, p_barangay text, p_public_lat double precision, p_public_lng double precision, p_address_line_1 text, p_exact_lat double precision, p_exact_lng double precision, p_amenity_ids bigint[] DEFAULT '{}'::bigint[], p_address_line_2 text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_postal_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_access_instructions text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_bedrooms smallint DEFAULT 0, p_bathrooms numeric DEFAULT 0, p_floor_area_sqm numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_floor_number smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint, p_total_floors smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint, p_furnishing_status furnishing_status DEFAULT 'unfurnished'::furnishing_status, p_max_occupants smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
    v_user_id uuid;
    v_property_id uuid;
begin
    -- 1. AUTHENTICATION
    v_user_id := auth.uid();

    if v_user_id is null then
        raise exception 'Authentication required'
            using errcode = '42501';
    end if;


    -- 2. ACTIVE ACCOUNT
    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.profiles p
        where p.id = v_user_id
          and p.account_status = 'active'::public.account_status
    ) then
        raise exception 'Active account required'
            using errcode = '42501';
    end if;


    -- 4. TIER 1 VERIFICATION
    if not public.is_tier1_verified(v_user_id) then
        raise exception 'Tier 1 verification required'
            using errcode = '42501';
    end if;


    -- 5. REQUIRED TEXT
    if p_barangay is null
       or pg_catalog.btrim(p_barangay) = '' then
        raise exception 'Barangay is required'
            using errcode = '22023';
    end if;

    if p_address_line_1 is null
       or pg_catalog.btrim(p_address_line_1) = '' then
        raise exception 'Address line 1 is required'
            using errcode = '22023';
    end if;


    -- 6. REQUIRED COORDINATES
    if p_public_lat is null
       or p_public_lng is null
       or p_exact_lat is null
       or p_exact_lng is null then
        raise exception 'Property coordinates are required'
            using errcode = '22023';
    end if;


    -- 7. COORDINATE RANGES
    if p_public_lat < -90
       or p_public_lat > 90
       or p_exact_lat < -90
       or p_exact_lat > 90 then
        raise exception 'Invalid latitude'
            using errcode = '22023';
    end if;

    if p_public_lng < -180
       or p_public_lng > 180
       or p_exact_lng < -180
       or p_exact_lng > 180 then
        raise exception 'Invalid longitude'
            using errcode = '22023';
    end if;


    -- 8. AMENITY VALIDATION
    if exists (
        select 1
        from pg_catalog.unnest(
            coalesce(
                p_amenity_ids,
                '{}'::bigint[]
            )
        ) as selected(amenity_id)

        left join public.amenities a
            on a.id = selected.amenity_id

        where a.id is null
           or a.is_active = false
    ) then
        raise exception 'One or more amenities are invalid or inactive'
            using errcode = '22023';
    end if;


    -- 9. CREATE PROPERTY
    insert into public.properties (
        landlord_id,
        property_type,
        city,
        barangay,
        public_location,
        bedrooms,
        bathrooms,
        floor_area_sqm,
        floor_number,
        total_floors,
        furnishing_status,
        max_occupants
    )
    values (
        v_user_id,
        p_property_type,
        p_city,
        pg_catalog.btrim(p_barangay),

        extensions.st_setsrid(
            extensions.st_makepoint(
                p_public_lng,
                p_public_lat
            ),
            4326
        )::extensions.geography,

        p_bedrooms,
        p_bathrooms,
        p_floor_area_sqm,
        p_floor_number,
        p_total_floors,
        p_furnishing_status,
        p_max_occupants
    )
    returning id into v_property_id;


    -- 10. CREATE PRIVATE LOCATION
    insert into public.property_private_locations (
        property_id,
        address_line_1,
        address_line_2,
        postal_code,
        exact_location,
        access_instructions
    )
    values (
        v_property_id,

        pg_catalog.btrim(p_address_line_1),

        nullif(
            pg_catalog.btrim(p_address_line_2),
            ''
        ),

        nullif(
            pg_catalog.btrim(p_postal_code),
            ''
        ),

        extensions.st_setsrid(
            extensions.st_makepoint(
                p_exact_lng,
                p_exact_lat
            ),
            4326
        )::extensions.geography,

        nullif(
            pg_catalog.btrim(p_access_instructions),
            ''
        )
    );


    -- 11. ATTACH AMENITIES
    insert into public.property_amenities (
        property_id,
        amenity_id
    )
    select
        v_property_id,
        selected.amenity_id
    from (
        select distinct
            pg_catalog.unnest(
                coalesce(
                    p_amenity_ids,
                    '{}'::bigint[]
                )
            ) as amenity_id
    ) selected;


    -- 12. RETURN RESULT
    return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'property_id', v_property_id,
        'status', 'created'
    );
end;
$function$

name: lock_owner
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rentlease_property_edit.lock_owner(p_property_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' then raise exception 'READ COMMITTED required' using errcode='25001';end if;
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_tier1_verified(auth.uid()) then
 raise exception 'Tier 1 active landlord required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_property_id::text,0));
 if not exists(select 1 from public.properties where id=p_property_id and landlord_id=auth.uid() and is_active) then
 raise exception 'Owned active property required' using errcode='42501';end if;
end$function$

name: rotate_property_details
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rentlease_property_edit.rotate_property_details()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if (to_jsonb(old)-array['updated_at','media_version','edit_version']) is distinct from (to_jsonb(new)-array['updated_at','media_version','edit_version']) then
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(new.id::text,0));
  new.edit_version:=gen_random_uuid();
 end if;return new;
end$function$

name: get_owned_property_edit_context
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_owned_property_edit_context(p_property_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 perform rentlease_property_edit.lock_owner(p_property_id);
 select jsonb_build_object('owner_id',p.landlord_id,'property_id',p.id,'edit_version',p.edit_version,'property_type',p.property_type,'city',p.city,'barangay',p.barangay,'floor_number',p.floor_number,
  'bedrooms',p.bedrooms,'bathrooms',p.bathrooms,'floor_area_sqm',p.floor_area_sqm,'max_occupants',p.max_occupants,'total_floors',p.total_floors,'furnishing_status',p.furnishing_status,
  'access_instructions',pl.access_instructions,
  'amenity_ids',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(amenity_id order by amenity_id) from public.property_amenities where property_id=p.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'catalog',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'name',a.name,'is_active',a.is_active) order by a.id) from public.amenities a where a.is_active or exists(select 1 from public.property_amenities pa where pa.property_id=p.id and pa.amenity_id=a.id)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'open_tenancy',exists(select 1 from public.tenancies t where t.property_id=p.id and t.status in ('proposed','pending_confirmation','active')))
 into result from public.properties p join public.property_private_locations pl on pl.property_id=p.id where p.id=p_property_id;
 if result is null then raise exception 'Saved private property context is missing' using errcode='22023';end if;
 return result;
end$function$

name: get_property_details_operation
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_property_details_operation(p_property_id uuid, p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 perform rentlease_property_edit.lock_owner(p_property_id);
 return (select result from rentlease_property_edit.detail_receipts where owner_id=auth.uid() and property_id=p_property_id and request_id=p_request_id);
end$function$
